question: ‘Shaheen – IX’, a joint air exercise was held in 2020 between:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan and China.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Shaheen – IX"** a joint **Air Force** exercise between **Pakistan and China.**
 
• It was the** ninth edition** of the Shaheen Air Force exercise.
 
• It is conducted **every year** in **both countries on an alternate basis.**
 
• The first edition of the Shaheen exercise was hosted by **Pakistan in 2011.**
 
• **Sea Guardians** is a bilateral Naval exercise between **Pakistan and China.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png]
